title: ExcellentCrates: текущий native-пул без frozen seasons
assumptions: Low/base/high are 0/1/5 keys opened per player day; this is a bounded load scenario, not measured key supply.
The change rebuilds the reward list from the currently loaded native crate on reload. It does not add a second roll or change bundle-size: 1.
Invalid reward definitions are omitted and logged; valid rewards remain weighted by their native weights.
Reward items, vouchers and keys are separate item units. No SELL value or Vault/Tokens exchange rate is assigned.

flows.basis: Current-pool rebuild changes eligibility of configured rewards, but each successful key debit still produces one durable weighted bundle.
